Order 
This is the third application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita , 2023/Section 439 of Cr.P.C., 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.417 of 2021 registered at Police Station - Lanji, District-Balaghat (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 366, 376, 376(A-B), 323, 506 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 5(M)/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

sentences.text: First bail application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 12.10.2023 passed in M.Cr.C. No.42463 of 2023 and the second bail application was dismissed on merits vide order dated 28.02.2024 passed in M.Cr.C. No.7799 of 2024.

2. Learned counsel for applicant has submitted that the first bail application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file repeat application after receipt of DNA report or on examination of the prosecutrix whichever is earlier vide order dated 12.10.2023 passed in NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:11848 2 MCRC-8115-2025 M.Cr.C. No.42463 of 2023 and when the victim was examined, second bail application was filed and the same was dismissed on merits vide order dated 28.02.2024 passed in M.Cr.C. No.7799 of 2024.

The instant application has been filed on the ground that the trial Court is vacant and the trial is not going on and the applicant is in custody since 03.07.2023, hence, the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
3. Learned counsel for State has opposed the bail application.

4. Heard the parties and perused the case diary.
5.
